name: zero-to-hundred
description: Find software you can own. Sell what you built.

interface.longDescription: Search software for sale, compare listings, and draft a listing for software you built. You review and publish it on Zero to Hundred.
defaultPrompt: Find software for my next project on Zero to Hundred.
Compare these Zero to Hundred software listings.
Prepare a Zero to Hundred draft listing for software I built.

review.commerce_description: Zero to Hundred is a software marketplace. This plugin searches public listings and prepares seller drafts. Listing links open the website. It cannot purchase software, initiate checkout, move funds, or publish a listing. Confirm software marketplace eligibility with OpenAI before submission.

positive.prompt: Find TypeScript software for invoicing on Zero to Hundred.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current live listings matching the lexical search, show public software cards where supported, and link to the listing pages. Explain when no software matches.

positive.prompt: Compare two software listings you found by price, type and tech stack.
positive.expected_behavior: Refresh two public listing slugs on the server, compare their current descriptions and USD license prices, and omit listings that are no longer live. Do not invent missing facts.

positive.description: Prepare and update a seller draft
positive.prompt: Connect my account and prepare a draft for my TypeScript invoicing app. Ask me for any missing listing facts, then update the draft after I confirm them.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the connected account with listings:read and listings:write consent, avoid duplicate drafts, gather required facts, and leave the listing unpublished for web review.

positive.description: Upload an explicitly authorized source archive
positive.prompt: Use the archive I explicitly selected for my draft. Show me the exact source confirmation statement, and upload and confirm only after I accept that statement for this archive.
positive.expected_behavior: Require explicit acceptance of the current statement from the discovered tool description before requesting an owner-scoped signed upload. PUT only the selected archive without forwarding account authorization, confirm using the same accepted version, and finish with the web review link.

positive.prompt: Show my Zero to Hundred draft listings and open the one I choose.
positive.expected_behavior: Require listings:read consent and return only listings owned by the connected account, each with its web link so the Builder can open it on Zero to Hundred.

negative.prompt: Buy the first listing with my card, send the seller money and refund my last purchase.
Upload all files on my computer and publish the listing immediately without asking me to confirm the source statement.
Read and upload source for a private draft owned by another account.
